subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Kurumi Fukuga from <Picture 1>, the college student with a loose chin-length pink bob, side-swept bangs, a small pale rectangular hair clip and pink-magenta eyes. Match her short-sleeved pale dress, rounded white collar, slim burgundy neck ribbon and burgundy waistband to the picture. A white flip phone is an added scene prop. The picture supplies her design for the whole shot.

summary:
[reference generation] An eight-second 2D anime comedy shot. The camera moves down a university corridor towards <Subject 1>. She turns to the viewer, asks a question in Mandarin, then flips open her phone beside her cheek and delivers the punchline.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - face, pink-magenta eyes, short bob silhouette, pale hair clip and ribbon-trimmed dress. Her pose, expression and distance from the camera change through the shot.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Begin at eye level in a long shot down a university corridor after class. The late sun makes a bright rectangle across the floor. <Subject 1> stands sideways at the far window, a small full-length figure whose pale dress and burgundy waistband catch the window light. The ends of her pink bob curve in around her jaw, well above her shoulders. She rocks forward on one foot to peek around the window frame. Her right hand loosely holds a closed white flip phone at her side, partly hidden by the skirt of her dress. Start moving towards her immediately. A nearby door jamb slides out of view much faster than the windows behind her. Keep this forward movement smooth and continuous.

As the view travels through a knees-up framing, she hears the approaching footsteps. Her eyes dart towards us first. Her head turns, then her shoulders. The short tips by her cheeks flick out and settle against her jaw. The pale clip stays in her bangs. She plants her heel and leans in with a look of delighted recognition. Ease the camera to a waist-up view with the window frame still behind the same shoulder. Her eyebrows lift as though she has a secret meant just for the person behind the lens. Her eyes meet ours. In a bright, conversational Mandarin voice <Subject 1> (S1) asks, <d>[Chinese] 老实赚钱很枯燥吧？</d> Her lips close briefly and she watches for our reaction.

During that pause she lifts the white handset from her side. Her thumb flips it open with one audible click. She turns the open inner display towards the lens and stops with it beside her cheek, on screen left. The display has just two bold dark letters, FX, above a simple red and green candlestick chart. The lower half of the phone has a physical keypad. Both her eyes and the entire upper display remain visible together. The camera finishes its push in a chest-up two-dimensional cel drawing, close enough to read the letters. Her smile breaks into a gleeful grin. With a small forward tilt of the handset, <Subject 1> (S1) says, <d>[Chinese] 快来试试FX吧！</d> She pronounces F and X as two letter names. Hold her look to camera for the last half-second as the short pink ends settle beside her cheek. The corridor stays quiet behind her.

overall_soundscape:
Soft indoor air and faint campus ambience, with space around the foreground voice.
